runSummary.note: Fresh 10.9.2026 18:23 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Praca za rohom, Kariera.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique candidate cleared the full locality, language, skill, activity and economics gates. Worki surfaced Expedient in Malacky at 1,530 EUR/month, but the canonical detail requires a valid forklift licence (VZV). Kariera surfaced fresh Bratislava administration listings, but visible concrete candidates carried low pay and/or multiple foreign-language requirements. LinkedIn again surfaced SupportYourApp remote support roles requiring fluent/C1 English. Upwork surfaced Worldwide WordPress/VA work, but current results were strong-English, expert/development-heavy, competitive or economically weak. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
